subject_group: 6.1.12 Characteristics of the primary flight control system

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that displays and instruments are safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.8.4 Displays and instruments. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation. Reference: MIL-STD-1797: 5.2.8.4 Displays and instruments.
